In a sponsored report published in the October issue of Real Assets Adviser, Steve Kirschner, senior vice president – national institutions at Redwood Investment Management, looks at the importance of knowing whether the distribution rate is funded by return of capital or net investment income. “A distribution rate tells an investor the size of a payment. The source tells them whether it was earned.
